Self-hosted ES-module bundle of the four @zag-js packages Vela imports by
bare name (vanilla, menu, dialog, tooltip) at 1.42.0, with their
dependencies pinned to the versions jsDelivr's +esm builds resolved to:
@floating-ui/dom 1.7.6, @floating-ui/core 1.7.5, @floating-ui/utils 0.2.11,
proxy-compare 3.0.1. Built with esbuild (--bundle --splitting --format=esm
--minify), so the shared zag core is ONE module instance across the four
entry files. Replaces 23 cross-origin cdn.jsdelivr.net requests on /charts.

Rebuild: npm i the four packages at 1.42.0 (with npm "overrides" pinning the
versions above), write entries/<name>.js = export * from '@zag-js/<name>',
then: esbuild entries/*.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify
  --target=es2020 --outdir=out --chunk-names=zag-[hash] --legal-comments=none
Bump the folder name when the version changes (assets are cached for a year).

All packages are MIT licensed. License texts follow.
